author: minimax-m2.5
brief: A plain data and script job on the same repository, with no user-interface work: write `scripts/check-countries.js` (Node, no dependencies) that reads `src/countries.js` data (the request names how to load it), and writes `reports/countries-check.json` with: duplicate codes, entries whose code is not two uppercase letters, names that differ only by case or accents, entries missing a field the registration page needs (the request names the fields), and a count per first letter of the name. It exits with code 1 when any problem is found and 0 otherwise. The request names the exact JSON field names and the sort order.
